question: What is the meaning of contact in normal use with humans and environment in relation to safety, health, environmental hygiene?
data_point: contact in normal use with humans and environment
description: Hazardous substances are those that can adversely affect human health or the environment with immediate or delayed effects, either on their own or through interaction with other factors. These substances are typically identified by international or national regulations that provide guidance on their proper processing and disposal to ensure safety, health, and environmental hygiene.
